theos is installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }} as release {{ .Release.Name }}.

The operator needs Agent Sandbox (its Sandbox kind) to start, its controller
without leader election, which makes one replica exit on a busy host:

  kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox/releases/download/v1.0.4/sandbox.yaml
  kubectl -n agent-sandbox-system patch deployment agent-sandbox-controller --type=json \
    -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/0","value":"--leader-elect=false"}]'

Check it:

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} get pods
{{- if .Values.ui.enabled }}

Open the read-only UI on http://localhost:8080:

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "theos.uiName" . }} 8080
{{- end }}
{{- range .Values.gitProviders }}

GitProvider {{ .name | default "git" }} in namespace {{ .namespace }} points at {{ .url }},
with the token in Secret {{ .existingSecret }}. Make it if it is missing:

  kubectl -n {{ .namespace }} create secret generic {{ .existingSecret }} \
    --from-literal=username=<user> --from-literal=token=<token>
{{- end }}
{{- if .Values.gitea.enabled }}
{{- $ns := include "theos.giteaNamespace" . }}

Gitea runs in namespace {{ $ns }} at {{ include "theos.giteaURL" . }}, seeded
with the tagged templates. Its admin password, and Gitea on http://localhost:3000:

  kubectl -n {{ $ns }} get secret {{ include "theos.giteaAdminSecret" . }} -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d; echo
  kubectl -n {{ $ns }} port-forward svc/gitea 3000
{{- range include "theos.projectNames" . | fromJsonArray }}

Project {{ . }}: organization {{ . }} in Gitea, GitProvider gitea in namespace {{ . }}.
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- if .Values.chat.enabled }}

theos-chat posts in each Chat's Matrix rooms. Each person adds themselves to
their project's Chat.spec.people (the chart's README.md, Chat).
{{- if include "theos.matrixEnabled" . }}
{{- $name := include "theos.matrixName" . }}
The in-cluster homeserver {{ .Values.chat.homeserver.serverName }}, on http://localhost:8008, and the
first passwords of chat.homeserver.accounts:

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ $name }} 8008
{{- range include "theos.matrixAccounts" . | fromJsonArray }}
  kubectl -n {{ $.Release.Namespace }} get secret {{ $name }}-account-{{ . }} -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d; echo
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
